title: Disc counting statistics of the real Ginibre ensemble
summary: We study the disc counting statistics of the real Ginibre ensemble, whose spectrum consists of real and non-real eigenvalues, the latter occurring in complex-conjugate pairs. As the matrix dimension increases, we derive the asymptotic behaviour of the joint cumulants of the numbers of real and non-real eigenvalues contained in a centred disc in the bulk, edge, and exterior regimes of the circular law.
